title: Host-granted rootless Docker functional fixture runner with bounded model repair
summary: Adds a default-disabled rootless Docker-only fixed Python solve(x)=2*x fixture evaluator with no repo mount/network, in-container resource checks, bounded child and sanitized unverified verdict; a two-candidate local-model coordinator uses syntax and functional feedback without granting any source edit, execution on the controller host or GitHub write.
migration_notes: No actual installed host, observed model inference, attested rootless container, user data change or product release. The controller does not execute generated code; only a separately operator-authorized rootless container may do so. P00-T20 stays IN_PROGRESS and PR #1 remains draft.
